symbols.reasoning: If already loading sets reload flag and returns; otherwise busy+read-state notification, loops clearing rows/errors, captures category/severity, queries current actor, discards mismatched filter responses and repeats. Failure sets error; success populates results. Finally always clears busy and notifies empty/list state. No cancellation, pagination or exception catch beyond finally; stale filter results are guarded.
